Select approved drugs with max_phase_for_ind = 4 and indication_label containing 'depressive disorder'. Join drug_indication on molregno, join molecule_dictionary for chembl_id and pref_name, join compound_structures for canonical_smiles as an INNER JOIN. Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, efo_id as indication_curie, mesh_heading as indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, max_phase_for_ind.
